game_title: Loop Counter Conveyor – Ore Vein Depths Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths, a rich ore vein: the cave miner must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths: a rich ore vein
core_gameplay_loop: In Ore Vein Depths, repeat each round: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the belt_count value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the cave gate using at most 23 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The cave gate reached with actions_used <= 23.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 23 before the cave gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Loop Counter Conveyor
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wraiths in Ore Vein Depths.
